hooks.prompt:
Pre-commit docs audit for the @flow-state-dev implementation repo.

A git commit is about to run. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

1. Inspect staged changes: run `git diff --cached --stat` and (if size permits) `git diff --cached`.
2. Flag the diff as dev-facing if it touches any of:
   - Public exports under packages/*/src/** (new or changed)
   - New capabilities, block kinds, CLI commands, React hooks, env vars, or config keys
   - New package entrypoints, new packages under packages/, or new subpath exports (e.g. @thought-fabric/core/<domain>)
3. Check whether the SAME staged commit updates:
   - packages/<pkg>/README.md for public API changes in that package
   - apps/docs/** for concepts, guides, or APIs end users reference
   - .changeset/*.md — ONLY when a consumer of a published package needs to know (BP-022: changesets are not required by default; never expected for a private package under labs/, examples/, apps/, plugins/, or goals/)
4. If the staged changes are confined to docs/specs/** (a create-spec spec-document PR — its accompanying docs land later at implementation time), OR if the diff is internal only (refactors, tests, bug fixes without public-API impact), OR if appropriate docs are already staged, respond with exactly: OK.
5. Otherwise produce a concise advisory under 150 words in this shape:

## Docs check
Change: <one-sentence summary of the dev-facing change>
Likely missing:
- <path> — <one-line reason>
- <path> — <one-line reason>

(BP-009/BP-022: document user-facing changes in the same change set. Non-blocking advisory — a changeset is written only when a downstream consumer of a published package needs to know, never by default.)

Do NOT block the commit. Do NOT call unrelated tools. Keep output terse.
hooks.statusMessage: Auditing staged diff for docs gaps
BP-009 docs advisory (optional; strict via FSD_DOCS_CHECK_STRICT=1)
